params.body:
A saved group on Accounts kept showing its name field and a toggle button per team member, so it looked like a form that hadn't been saved yet.

A saved group now reads as one line: its name, the people in it ("Maarten, Guilherme", or "Nobody in it yet"), and **Change** and **Remove**. **Change** opens that group into the name field and the people to click. A new group (from **Add a group**) opens straight away. **Save the groups** and **Cancel** appear only while something is being changed, and **Cancel** closes every opened group again.

Saving is unchanged: the whole set goes to `/config/team-groups` as before.

Tests: `e2e/accounts.spec.js` (the group test now checks the saved line and opens it with Change), 4 of 4 passing. ESLint is clean on the changed files.
params.title: Show a saved group as a line, open it with Change
